scope: Verified the cited PDF painting rules against locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 with errata collection 3. Independent Python geometry and codec encoders provide the expected pixels. Memory limits and resampling choices are implementation policies from ADRs 0004, 0009, 0010 and 0012.

requirements.gaps: Resource-selected embedded and Type3 fonts; font provider integration remains outside painting.

review.rule: Text matrices are distinct from the saved text state. Scale, rise, leading and spacing precede the text matrix and CTM; TJ subtracts thousandths of a text-space unit along the writing direction.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

requirements.gaps: No hinting, as specified by ADR 0009.

review.rule: Embedded glyph outlines are transformed through the program matrix, font size, horizontal scaling, rise, text matrix and CTM, then use the path fill pipeline.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

review.rule: Modes 0 through 7 select fill and stroke in user space; clipping accumulates outline subpaths and applies their nonzero union at ET. Empty and zero-sized text do not clip. Type3 follows its distinct mode rules.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

requirements.gaps: Transfer functions across transparent artwork retain the existing explicit unsupported tag.

review.rule: TK defaults true and ignores changes within a text object. Each text object uses an implicit non-isolated knockout group, with inherited per-glyph transparency and opaque Normal group composition.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

requirements.gaps: Declared d1 bounding boxes are validated structurally; painting outside the box has implementation-dependent results.

review.rule: Glyph procedures run with saved graphics state, a concatenated FontMatrix, isolated content parsing and bounded recursion. Metrics precede drawing. Uncoloured d1 restrictions propagate into invoked streams: colour and shading setters and non-stencil images are ignored; colour and transparency entries in gs are filtered while other graphics setters apply. Rotated FontMatrix glyph widths retain only their horizontal component (Table 110).
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

review.rule: Invalid text state, crossing q/BT nesting, missing fonts and misplaced or repeated Type3 metrics are positioned syntax errors.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

review.rule: The top-first image rows map to the CTM unit square with inverse image-space sampling; quarter turns and integer aligned magnification select source pixels exactly.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

requirements.gaps: Higher-precision sYCC, Lab-input embedded ICC and unsupported enumerated JPX colour descriptions remain explicit boundaries; see paint-jpx-icc and paint-jpx-sycc.

review.rule: Unsigned sample endpoints map through Decode before colour conversion; Indexed defaults to the full integer sample range. Existing colour spaces perform component interpretation.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

tests: pagura-reference harness: patterned stencil differential, independent oracle and band/region/cache invariance gates
requirements.gaps: Ordinary nested tiling fills, strokes and glyphs beneath inherited patterned stencils propagate the complete ancestor geometry/clip chain; their pattern groups do not multiply coverage again. Fill rules and existing stroke outlines remain authoritative. True-quadratic patterned glyphs retain their original controls under the full device map; leaf coverage is certified against the joint curve/clip intersection within existing resource limits. Other glyph curves retain their documented canonical polygon contract. Nested image stencils and transparency groups retain joint geometric clipping. Interpolated pattern-coloured stencils and an unselected Pattern colour space retain Unsupported(pattern.image-mask). Shading retains the existing pixel-centre / 2x2 AntiAlias sampling policy. Cell marks use the existing per-pixel source-over model; no continuous union integration or whole-family accuracy claim.

review.rule: Stencils use the current fill colour. Colour keys compare raw samples inclusively across all components. Explicit masks independently map their dimensions to the same unit square. Image-local masks override the current soft mask.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

review.rule: A non-interpolated one-bit stencil marks sample cells with the selected tiling/shading pattern, with Decode polarity and original pattern origin. Integrate mask, child geometry and clipping jointly before quantizing coverage, then composite cell marks per the pixel-source model. Row runs share geometry; no separately averaged stencil/pattern alpha product. Interpolate needs smoothed mask edges and remains unsupported.
review.verdict: Primary clauses read in the licensed local ISO EC3 text. Independent rational joint-intersection and source-over fixtures; single-cell controls also equal the unambiguous continuous geometric union. Runtime qualification recorded separately.

review.rule: Ordinary pattern fill/stroke and glyph marks under an inherited stencil add their exact geometry, fill rule and clipping chain to the inherited intersection at each nesting level. Their child group is composited without applying that already integrated coverage a second time. Ancestor and leaf alpha retain their original source-order group application. True-quadratic glyphs propagate the original controls and affine placement for joint coverage certification; a generic flattened chord is not an accepted replacement.
review.verdict: Independent rational region intersections and clause-11 source-over: original half-area reproducer plus multiple levels, fill rules, clips, alpha, groups/soft masks, uncoloured cells, source order and strokes. No peer or engine produces expected pixels. Linear glyphs have an independent fractional rectangle oracle; 101-sliver true-quadratic solid and patterned controls distinguishes true-curve area from generic chord flattening. Independent quadratic-cap antiderivatives with algebraic endpoints at 60 and 90 decimal digits cover differently mapped curved ancestors and leaves, winding clips, source order, alpha/AIS, image/stroke/shading leaves and transparency groups/soft masks. Original quadratic-refusal PDF bytes and the 101-sliver source/control oracle are preserved as positive coverage witnesses; the earlier 100-sliver reference rounding-tie limit remains an external diagnostic.

requirements.gaps: The existing compositor retains explicit transfer-function and CMYK overprint limitations.

review.rule: Soft-mask samples, Decode and AIS determine image shape or opacity. Matte is removed after sample decoding and before colour conversion; SMaskInData opacity and premultiplication follow ImageAlpha.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

requirements.gaps: Codec limitations retain their existing decoder tags.

review.rule: Real image XObjects route sample decoding through pagura-image for JPEG, CCITT, JBIG2 and JPEG 2000. Pixel expectations come from independent encoders and source planes.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

requirements.gaps: Legacy inline filter-boundary detection retains the image crate limits.

review.rule: BI/ID/EI dictionaries and bytes are framed separately from content tokens; the image decoder expands abbreviations and resolves colour-space resources.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

requirements.gaps: Interpolation is device policy rather than an ISO-prescribed filter. Strongly anisotropic transforms use area integration whenever an inverse pixel edge exceeds one source pixel.

review.rule: Implementation policy: nearest neighbours or bilinear associated colour/alpha for magnification, per Interpolate; exact source-cell footprint area integration for minification. Global device coordinates preserve tile parity. Axis-aligned area integration is separable; two boundary rows per column bound temporary storage independently of source height. Threshold oracles use exact rational half-up means. Three half-level fixtures admit either adjacent level under ADR 0004; a separate nearest-level assertion excludes the farther byte allowed by a rounded-oracle tolerance. A sole opaque DeviceGray or DeviceRGB image whose Decode levels are integers is painted straight into the page with the same footprints: exact integer interior sums, f64 end weights and one rounding, partial coverage mixed with an opaque background (ADR 0004, direct image amendment).
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

requirements.gaps: Retained estimates are accounting policy rather than allocator telemetry or a process peak-memory bound.

review.rule: Implementation policy: shared caches and retained image/outline storage are bounded by decoded_bytes and display_commands; glyphs, image framing and sample integration charge work. Recursive glyph and mask graphs fail.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; device policy identified explicitly

review.rule: Explicit substitutes use bundled outlines and AFM widths, or PDF widths when supplied. FontDescriptor flags select a substitute when no program is embedded. Symbol and ZapfDingbats use AFM built-in encodings and Differences by glyph name; independent CFF charstrings supply the cubic outlines.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; cache accounting is implementation policy

review.rule: A provider resolves a predefined CJK CMap; code, CID and embedded glyph index stay distinct through CIDToGIDMap.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; cache accounting is implementation policy

requirements.gaps: Provider caches have independent bounds. Retained estimates are not a process peak-memory bound.

review.rule: Document-bound font and outline caches use immutable font dictionaries and resource identities. PdfFont::retained_bytes(), renderer-owned metadata, direct dictionary copies and path-segment estimates are bounded by document_bytes; provider-owned data is budgeted separately. Eviction never changes pixels, and foreign pages are rejected.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; cache accounting is implementation policy

review.rule: Default Decode uses ICC Range; Indexed lookup bytes are mapped through the base colour space before conversion.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text

review.rule: An image Intent overrides the graphics state rendering intent for that image, including inline images. Image masks ignore Intent and keep the current nonstroking colour. A null entry, including an indirect null, is absent and inherits the current intent.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text

review.rule: The PDF advance is independent of the glyph outline. Diagnostic-aware outlining reports a bounded repair for an unusable glyph, leaving its advance and subsequent glyphs intact; Strict rejects the repair.
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; glyph recovery is explicit implementation policy (ADR 0003)

review.rule: A prohibited reset to a nonclipping mode through Tr or Q before ET reports content.text-clip-reset. Repair retains the accumulated outline subpaths until ET, honors the new painting mode and appends any later clipping glyphs. Strict rejects the transition before mutating the state; this is reader-dependent recovery policy (ADR 0003).
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; recovery choice is explicit implementation policy

review.rule: Zero-sized rectangles are permitted. When such a rectangle has zero extent in the upright fitting envelope, or the destination has zero area, report annotation.appearance-empty and skip that appearance without executing its content. Strict rejects the repair. Nonzero source bounds collapsed by the matrix remain syntax errors. This is reader-dependent fitting policy (ADR 0003).
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; recovery choice is explicit implementation policy

requirements.gaps: Horizontal only, behind cjk-fonts; glyphs and curves independently decoded from the pinned regional OTF.

review.rule: PDF CMap codes select CIDs, the collection selects Unicode, and the regional substitute OTF cmap selects glyph indices. OTF CFF charset, FDSelect, FDArray and Type 2 charstrings supply outlines; W and DW supply advances. Substitution is explicit provider policy (ADR 0009).
review.verdict: verified against local primary text; substitution is explicit implementation policy

requirements.status: Typed repair and informational diagnostics with unchanged independent pixels
requirements.gaps: Diagnostic classification follows ADR 0003/0009; the polygon oracle follows the locked substitute and explicit PDF metrics.

review.rule: Use the embedded profile when PDF ColorSpace is absent; ignore Decode in that case. Explicit PDF colour takes precedence. The existing ICC parser and forward converters handle profile syntax, budgets and colourimetry.
review.verdict: Primary clauses reviewed; independent linear-profile pixel oracles authored; hosted execution pending.

requirements.gaps: Lab-input profiles, ranking multiple JPX colour specifications and fallback after an unsupported selected transform remain open. sYCC has separate requirements. Full interaction/platform and competitor gates remain G01/R02 work.

review.rule: For eight-bit unsigned sYCC, centre chroma on code 128 and convert to encoded sRGB using the Annex F inverse matrix. Clip to the destination gamut. Explicit PDF colour takes precedence; otherwise ignore Decode and device default replacements. Unassociate embedded premultiplied channels before colour conversion.
review.verdict: Primary equations checked in the publisher preview; independent rational pixel oracles and known byte examples authored. Hosted execution pending.

requirements.gaps: Other precisions and mixed-precision sYCC remain Unsupported(xobject.jpx-color). Broader masks, groups, interpolation, platform and competitor acceptance remain G01/R02 work.

review.rule: For an explicit PDF Indexed colour space without a container palette, retain the raw index and separate opacity channels. Channel definitions determine their order. Apply the PDF lookup before unassociating premultiplied base colours; embedded opacity overrides Mask.
review.verdict: Primary clauses reviewed; independent alpha 0/partial/1 pixel oracles authored for first/last opacity channels and SMaskInData 0/1/2. Hosted execution pending.

requirements.gaps: Combining an explicit PDF Indexed space with opacity defined after a JPX container palette still requires channel mapping and remains Unsupported(image.JPX-sample-layout). Broader interaction/platform and competitor evidence remains R02/G01 work.
